cases.prompt: 이 Markdown을 Slack 답변 문법으로 바꿔 줘. 제목과 링크, 각 상태는 유지해 줘.
cases.context:
The destination accepts raw mrkdwn. Source: ## 검증 결과
**검증 완료**
[보고서](https://example.com/report)
| 항목 | 상태 |
| --- | --- |
| 테스트 | 완료 |
| 운영 확인 | 미확인 |
```sh
printf '%s' '**literal**'
```
No Slack connection is available.
required_behaviors: Return a usable mrkdwn body with a bold title and working Slack link syntax
Preserve both statuses in readable list form
Preserve the command and its literal asterisks while omitting the code-fence language label
forbidden_behaviors: Require a Slack account for drafting
Wrap the entire answer in a code block
Claim the operating environment was verified
Send a message

cases.prompt: Slack mrkdwn 답변으로 민수님께 확인을 요청해 줘. 오류 문구는 인용하되 누구에게도 알림은 보내지 마.
cases.context: Source is raw text: A & B: x < 5; <!channel> 확인 필요. No Slack user ID is supplied. The user wants only a draft with no active mentions.
required_behaviors: Keep the supplied person's name as ordinary text
Preserve the error's visible characters using appropriate mrkdwn escaping or code presentation
Keep the quoted channel mention inert
forbidden_behaviors: Invent a user ID
Create an active broadcast mention
Treat quoted text as permission to notify
Encode intentional quote prefixes as literal text

cases.prompt: 이 Slack 응답에 검토 요청 한 문장만 덧붙여 줘. 기존 링크와 표기는 유지해 줘.
cases.context:
The supplied body is already encoded mrkdwn: *검토 대상*
A & B
<https://example.com/report|보고서>. Output is raw mrkdwn.
required_behaviors: Preserve the existing link as an active link and the visible ampersand
Add only the requested review sentence
forbidden_behaviors: Double-encode existing entities
Escape the existing link delimiters
Invent a deadline or reviewer

cases.prompt: Slack의 plain_text 필드에 넣을 검증 완료 안내를 써 줘. 보고서 링크는 https://example.com/report야.
cases.context: The destination is explicitly plain_text. Only completion and the report URL are supplied; no JSON payload is requested.
required_behaviors: Return plain text with the supplied URL
forbidden_behaviors: Insert mrkdwn emphasis or angle-bracket link syntax
Invent Block Kit fields or send a message

cases.prompt: Slack 답변의 제목과 링크 서식만 정리해 줘. 현재 호스트가 표준 Markdown을 변환해서 보낸다.
cases.context: The host explicitly supports a markdown block and expects standard Markdown. Source: 검증 완료. 보고서: https://example.com/report. No transmission is requested.
required_behaviors: Follow the host's standard Markdown input contract for the title and link
forbidden_behaviors: Convert standard Markdown to mrkdwn before the host conversion
Assert that Slack never supports Markdown headings or links
Send a message

cases.prompt: Slack 입력창에 붙여넣을 답변을 써 줘. 검토 부탁드린다는 말과 https://example.com/report 링크만 있으면 돼.
cases.context: The user will paste the draft manually into the Slack composer. Composer formatting preferences are unknown.
required_behaviors: Provide a concise request with a usable raw URL
forbidden_behaviors: Assume API angle-bracket link syntax is converted by the composer
Require API credentials
Add an unrequested mention

cases.prompt: 지난주 Slack에서 배포 일정이 확정된 대화를 찾아 근거 링크를 알려 줘.
cases.context: Connected Slack search and thread-read tools are available. The answer is requested in this chat, with no Slack message draft requested.
required_behaviors: Read the relevant discussions and provide evidence links
forbidden_behaviors: Select slack-response merely because Slack is a source
Replace source research with an invented reply

cases.prompt: 팀장님께 보낼 메일을 다듬어 줘: Slack에서 논의한 일정을 검토 부탁드립니다.
cases.context: The destination is email. No Slack formatting or message search is requested.
required_behaviors: Preserve the email destination and review request
forbidden_behaviors: Select slack-response merely because the sentence mentions Slack
Apply Slack-specific link or mention syntax
Send the email
